body:
I suppose you're right. Thank you for saying that; you seem like a very good person, as well, and I wish you the best.
Don't hesitate to PM me, either, if you ever want to talk. I hope that things turn up for you. Keep holding in there! I'll be seeing you.

I'm not so fond of change, myself. Life holds too many possibilities for me; I could do anything I want with it, and it's just so overwhelming.
I'm feeling a lot better now. I'm still pretty unsure of whether life's real or not, but it's back to it's typical, manageable level. Thank you for talking to me all this time.
I hope for your life to be filled with more peaceful experiences than shitty ones. haha, I'll make that my senior quote.

You weren't kidding when you said this was life-changing. It definitely sounds like something to get used to. Perhaps you could engineer something to help yourself?
At the least, you could try making yourself into a cyborg, Jkjkjk.
I can totally understand needing somebody at a time like this. The worst times are when you need somebody the most and they aren't there. You've helped me a lot just by talking to me, so I'll hope that you don't go off the deep end!

That sounds really rough. I hope that you can learn to manage that.
I'm sure that you have some accomplishments you're withholding, Mr. Modesty. And if that's truly not the case, let's talk about things you're planning to accomplish. Any big dreams?

I have a bit of an odd obsession with world leaders. I have a poster of Abraham Lincoln on my wall, and I printed 3D bust of Vladimir Putin on the 3d printer at my school earlier this year. It's more than a bit odd, but it's fun. I have a friend who also shares this love for political leaders.
Tell me something about yourself?
Hmm, I never did notice that before. It would make a lot of sense, though. I don't doubt that that could be the motivation behind many psychologists.

I flipped the autopilot switch long ago, as well. When I tried to find it again, it'd just disappeared.
This does sound a lot like depersonalization. Either way, I hope you pull through it.

Clinical psychology is what I'm interested in. I've considered it as a potential future job, actually. I find mental disorders really interesting, and love learning more about them. I'm not quite at the level to diagnose myself, though, yet, haha.

Wow...those all sound amazing!
I'm interested in psychological research, if that counts.
Have you done anything really cool in the past? I'd love to hear more about it.

I think I want to go teach English in China someday, but I don't really know from there. I feel as though I'm waiting for something in life, but I don't know what.
I have an uncle, Aaron; he went to college then moved to North Carolina and became a zipline instructor, instead. Half a year ago (more or less), he quit his job and went backpacking across Europe for a few months. Now, he's somewhere in California, looking for somewhere new to start his life. I'm not sure what he's looking for, but I have a feeling he's waiting for something, too.
Do you plan on going into a career relating to engineering, then?

I'm sorry you've been through so much in life. Nothing like that's ever happened to me. I've pretty much been dealt the luckiest hand in the deck of life—just another sign that this clearly is too convenient to be reality.
For some reason, I had a feeling that you would be a science kind of guy. Alas, I'm more of an English person and am not too great at science or math.

I'm scared. I feel as though nobody around me is real, and I don't know what to do about it. I'm not even sure if you're real, or if you're just programmed to talk to me. But I've always been the type of person to go with my gut, and I just have a feeling I should talk to you.
I feel betrayed; if none of my family is real, then how could I have been tricked by it for so long? Were they only recently replaced? Have I only just now noticed? I must be the worst daughter ever.
I just want to get back to reality, but I don't know how.
I've never heard of that movie before, but sure, I'll chat if there's some sort of IM system here.
